measure: Study permit holders, year in which permit became effective
definition: Official IRCC count of study permit holders by the year, quarter or month in which the permit became effective, by province or territory of intended destination and study level. This is not a year-end stock, and it is not an asylum or work-permit count.

measure: Study permit holders with a valid permit on 31 December
definition: Official IRCC count of study permit holders who held a valid permit on 31 December, by province or territory of intended destination and study level. This is a year-end stock. It is not comparable with the permit-effective measure, and it is not a work-permit or asylum count.

measure: TFWP work permit holders, year in which permit became effective
definition: Official IRCC count of Temporary Foreign Worker Program work permit holders by the year, quarter or month in which the permit became effective, by province or territory of intended destination and program. This is not a year-end stock, and it must not be added to IMP, study-permit or asylum figures.

measure: IMP work permit holders, year in which permit became effective
definition: Official IRCC count of International Mobility Program work permit holders by the year, quarter or month in which the permit became effective, by province or territory of intended destination and program. This is not a year-end stock, and it must not be added to TFWP, study-permit or asylum figures.

measure: Asylum claimants by claim office type
definition: Official IRCC count of individuals who made a refugee claim at a port of entry or a designated IRCC office, by claim office type, province or territory of claim, and claim month or year. The provincial field follows the official footnote on inland office, last known address, or non-inland office. This is not a permit-holder count.
